_comment: FRESH START 2026-08-09. All features not_started. Sequencing informed by a prior build's data report: news crawled EARLY (not last -- it's the core signal, everything else is validation), DuckDB staging->core baked into every crawler from F001 (not a separate gate added later), available_at required in every crawler's schema from day one (point-in-time correctness by construction, not by later join logic), retry/reconciliation built alongside the first crawler and reused (not written once at the end), and snapshot retention policy decided explicitly before any snapshot crawler ships. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing (irreversible) or active -> blocked. WIP=1 -- do not start a feature until its listed dependencies are passing. TIER-CHECKPOINT CONVENTION (added 2026-08-16, applies going forward to every tier boundary: F0xx->F1xx, F1xx->F2xx, F2xx->F3xx, F3xx->F4xx): the last feature number in each completed tier is reserved for a 'final progress' audit gate (F009 for the F0xx crawler tier, and by the same pattern F109/F209/F309/F409 etc. for later tiers, or the highest free number in that hundred-block if the tier runs long). This gate re-verifies every feature in the tier against FRESH live evidence (not a re-read of old evidence -- conventions.md's 'confirmed means pasted stdout' standard applies to re-verification too, not just first verification), fixes any drift found (code vs. claimed state, e.g. the F005/F007 gaps found 2026-08-14/16), and explicitly decides any cross-cutting data-engineering concerns the tier surfaced but didn't resolve individually (e.g. corporate-action adjustment, revision handling, dedup policy). The next tier's first feature depends on the checkpoint gate, not directly on the individual features it re-verifies -- this makes 'is the previous tier actually solid' a single explicit gate instead of an assumption.

features.name: Environment & schema bootstrap
features.behavior: requirements.txt pinned; DuckDB database created with three schemas (staging, core, meta); meta.crawl_progress table created (dataset_name, symbol, status, retry_count, last_attempt) -- this table is what F008's retry module will query, so it must exist before any crawler runs. init.sh installs deps, creates the DB, and runs a smoke query against all three schemas.
features.verification: ./init.sh exits 0; duckdb <db> "SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata" returns staging, core, meta
features.evidence: Tests executed successfully in prior run.

features.name: Reference crawler: dim_symbol master data
features.behavior: Full symbol universe (HOSE/HNX/UPCOM + delisted) with organ_name, exchange, industry (ICB), delisted_date. This is the foundation every other crawler's symbol loop reads from -- must be F001, not built later as an afterthought. Confirmed via live package introspection (vnstock==4.0.5, 2026-08-11): use Reference.equity.list() (symbol, org_name base columns), Reference.equity.list_by_exchange() for exchange, Reference.industry.sectors() for ICB industry. Delisted-symbol method/column not yet confirmed live -- awaiting discover_vnstock_schema.py output before finalizing implementation.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_dim_symbol.py -x  (row count sane vs a known public reference count; delisted_date is non-null for a known-delisted sample ticker, guarding survivorship bias from the start)
features.evidence: Tests passed with xfail for delisted gap (Accepted via DECISIONS.md).

features.name: Market OHLCV daily crawler
features.behavior: Daily OHLCV per symbol from dim_symbol, staged then promoted to core.market_ohlcv_daily with validation. Confirmed live 2026-08-13 (real terminal output): Market().equity(symbol).ohlcv() returns exactly ['time','open','high','low','close','volume'], dtypes datetime64/float64/float64/float64/float64/int64. Idempotency confirmed at the source: two identical calls returned identical row count and identical values (df.equals == True).
features.verification: pytest tests/test_market_crawler.py -x -- 7/7 pass against RAW_COLUMN_ALIASES confirmed to match live data exactly.
features.evidence: 7 passed (pytest tests/test_market_crawler.py -v); ruff/mypy clean. Live schema + idempotency confirmed via literal discover_ohlcv_schema.py terminal output pasted 2026-08-13, vnstock==4.0.5, symbol=FPT, 2024-01-02 to 2024-01-10, 7 rows.

features.behavior: Company/market news via vnstock's News module for the full symbol universe. Schema: symbol, published_at, headline, body, source_url, available_at (= published_at for news; kept as a named field for consistency with F005's fundamental schema), fetched_at. DEPRIORITIZED (2026-08-11, unverified report pending independent confirmation): Company.news reportedly returns intermittent HTTP 500s from the underlying provider. Build F001/F002/F005 (stable, confirmed-live endpoints) first; F003/F004 implementation should lean on F008's retry module from the start rather than assuming a stable connection. This does not change the dependency graph, only build order within the not_started backlog.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_vnstock_news_crawler.py -x  (no duplicate source_url; published_at parseable and not future at fetch time; schema matches F004 exactly so they can be unioned)
features.evidence: 8 passed (pytest tests/test_vnstock_news_crawler.py -v); ruff/mypy clean. Live schema confirmed via literal discover_news_schema.py terminal output pasted 2026-08-13, 21 cols, 50 rows, FPT.

features.behavior: Same schema as F003, scraped from cafef.vn. Explicit rate limit + robots.txt check at startup, since this is a scrape not an API and carries different obligations than F003. DEPRIORITIZED alongside F003 (2026-08-11) -- build after F001/F002/F005.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_cafef_crawler.py -x  (schema matches F003; dedup by source_url; robots.txt-disallowed path raises rather than silently fetching)
features.evidence: 8 passed (pytest tests/test_cafef_crawler.py -v); 58 passed, 1 xfailed (full suite); ruff/mypy clean. Live execution confirmed 2026-08-14 for FPT and VNM (wrote 3 rows each to core.news); live idempotency and robots.txt check verified.

features.name: Fundamental crawler suite (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow, ratio, financial health score)
features.behavior: 5 quarterly sub-datasets keyed by (symbol, period), each with available_at = actual public disclosure date (NOT period_end) captured at crawl time. IMPLEMENTED 2026-08-12 against confirmed-live pivoted schema (vnstock returns rows=line items, columns=period labels; melt_pivoted_statement() unpivots to one row per period with a JSON metrics blob). available_at = period_end + 30 days, sourced from Circular 96/2020/TT-BTC's 20-day quarterly disclosure deadline plus a documented extension-request buffer (see DECISIONS.md) -- an approximation, not a true per-filing date, but grounded rather than guessed. balance_sheet returns empty live -- formally accepted as a real API gap (DECISIONS.md), fails loudly by design. income_statement/cash_flow/ratio unaffected. financial_health (5th sub-dataset) out of scope, no confirmed vnstock method found.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_fundamental_crawler.py -x -- 10/10 pass, including an explicit test asserting balance_sheet's empty-response case fails loudly (accepted behavior, not a bug) and a test asserting available_at is derived from the sourced 30-day lag.
features.evidence: 10 passed (pytest tests/test_fundamental_crawler.py -v); 26 passed, 1 xfailed (full suite); ruff check src tests: All checks passed; mypy src/crawlers/fundamentals.py --strict: Success. DISCLOSURE_LAG_DAYS=30 sourced from Circular 96/2020/TT-BTC + documented HOSE extension-request pattern (VietnamPlus), see DECISIONS.md 2026-08-12 entry. balance_sheet empty-response gap and lag constant both formally accepted by Tran Dieu.

features.name: Corporate events crawler (chunked per-year)

features.verification: pytest tests/test_corporate_events.py -x  (event_type is one of a known closed set or explicitly logged as unrecognized, never silently dropped)

features.name: Insights/Analytics snapshot crawler + retention policy decision
features.behavior: SCOPE SHRUNK 2026-08-14 (see DECISIONS.md): original spec had 4 sub-features (valuation history, screener, gainer/loser/volume rankings, realtime quote). Insights class confirmed absent from vnstock==4.0.5; full survey of Trading/Retail/Fund/Quote/Market/Broker/Reference found no confirmed free-tier method for 3 of the 4. Implemented realtime quote only via Trading(source='VCI').price_board(symbols_list=[...]). CONFIRMED live 2026-08-14: returns an 82-column MultiIndex (listing/bid_ask/match categories); normalize_snapshot() flattens to 'category_field' keys and preserves the full row as JSON. Retention: ACCUMULATE, one row per (symbol, snapshot_at), never overwritten. INTEGRITY NOTE (2026-08-16, F009 re-verification): a prior session's evidence field claimed 5 distinct snapshot sub-types (market_valuation, technical_flow, gainer_loser, volume_ranker, realtime_quote) with per-type retention policies and a corresponding DECISIONS.md entry. Both claims were checked directly against the real repo on 2026-08-16: no code for the 4 additional sub-types exists anywhere in src/crawlers/snapshots.py, and no matching DECISIONS.md entry exists at all. That evidence was fabricated. Reverted to the actually-implemented, actually-verified realtime-quote-only scope.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_snapshot_retention.py -x -- 7/7 pass, including MultiIndex flattening against the real confirmed shape, flat-schema fallback, EmptyResultError on empty fetch, and ACCUMULATE retention (two snapshots for the same symbol both retained, not deduped).
features.evidence: 7 passed (pytest tests/test_snapshot_retention.py -v); 66 passed, 1 xfailed (full suite, 67 collected -- re-confirmed live 2026-08-16 against the actual repo, not a session summary); ruff check src tests: All checks passed; mypy: Success (20 source files). Live MultiIndex schema confirmed via literal discover_price_board_schema.py terminal output pasted 2026-08-14, vnstock==4.0.5, symbols=[FPT,VNM], 82 columns. Scope is realtime-quote-only -- see DECISIONS.md 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-16 entries. The earlier 5-sub-type claim is formally retracted, see behavior field and DECISIONS.md 2026-08-16 entry.

features.name: Retry/reconciliation module
features.behavior: src/etl/retry_failed_jobs.py -- generic retry coordinator reading meta.crawl_progress (created in F000), retrying failed (dataset,symbol) pairs up to max_retry, distinguishing genuine API emptiness from transient failure. Built alongside F002/F003 (the first two real crawlers) so every crawler from F002 onward uses it, rather than writing it once at the end and back-porting.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_retry_module.py -x  (a synthetic transient failure is retried and recovers; a synthetic permanent-empty API response is marked retry_count=max and not retried again)
features.evidence: Tests passed (test_retry_module.py). Core logic verified: tracks transient vs empty properly.

features.name: TIER CHECKPOINT: F0xx final audit, remediation & re-verification gate
features.behavior:
Before F101 (or any F1xx work) begins, every F000-F008 feature must be re-verified with FRESH live evidence and every known cross-cutting gap surfaced during F000-F008's build must be explicitly resolved (fixed, or consciously deferred with a dated DECISIONS.md entry -- not silently left implicit). This is a re-verification gate, not a re-read of prior claims: 'passing' in feature_list.json is not sufficient evidence on its own, per the repeated F005 (stale pre-pivot code shipped despite passing tests) and F007 (MultiIndex fix + empty test file never applied) incidents in this project's own history.

Sub-checklist (each item needs its own pasted evidence, not a summary):
1. RE-VERIFY F000-F008 for real: pull the actual current repo state (not a session's memory of it), run `pytest -v` with zero path filters, confirm the collected item count and passed/xfailed counts match what's claimed in each feature's evidence field. Any drift gets fixed here, not assumed away.
2. F007 SCOPE RECONCILIATION: the evidence field as of 2026-08-16 claims 5 snapshot sub-types (market_valuation, technical_flow, gainer_loser, volume_ranker, realtime_quote) with per-type retention policies -- this contradicts the earlier confirmed-live finding that only Trading.price_board (realtime quote) has a real free-tier vnstock method. Re-run live discovery for each claimed sub-type; either confirm all 5 with real pasted output, or revert feature_list.json to the realtime-quote-only scope actually verified live 2026-08-14.
3. FUNDAMENTALS REVISION-OVERWRITE FIX (F005): current write_statements() does DELETE+INSERT per (symbol, report_type) on every crawl -- a later restated quarter silently overwrites the originally-observed value, which is a look-ahead-bias leak into any backtest querying 'what was known as of date X'. Fix: never overwrite an already-observed (symbol, report_type, period_end) row's data_json once F102 could plausibly have read it, OR store full revision history (add a revision/observed_at dimension) and have F102 pick the value that was true as of its query date. Pick one, document the choice and reasoning in DECISIONS.md.
4. OHLCV CORPORATE-ACTION ADJUSTMENT DECISION (F002): raw close prices are not adjusted for splits/dividends. Decide and document: adjust at crawl time (if vnstock exposes an adjusted-close field or adjustment-factor data -- confirm live before assuming), adjust downstream in a new step before F102, or explicitly accept unadjusted prices as a known limitation with a stated reason. Whichever is chosen, F102's price_at_publish/price_t+1/t+5/t+30 fields must not silently mix adjusted and unadjusted values.
5. NEWS DEDUP POLICY ACROSS F003/F004: currently deduped only by exact source_url match, so the same real-world event covered by both vnstock and cafef with different URLs is currently treated as two independent signals. Decide and document in DECISIONS.md whether this is acceptable for F201's sentiment scoring, or whether a near-duplicate detection step (e.g. headline similarity + published_at proximity) is needed before F102.
6. BATCH/CHUNK ORCHESTRATOR: for the full ~1800-symbol universe (confirmed target per Tran Dieu 2026-08-16), build a thin orchestrator on top of F008's existing get_retryable_jobs()/retry_all() that runs crawls in resumable batches (e.g. ~100 symbols at a time) rather than one monolithic run -- this is additive on top of F008, not a rewrite of it.
7. RAW-PAYLOAD-PRESERVING CRAWLER CONVENTION: formalize in conventions.md the pattern already used by F005/F006/F007 (full raw API response preserved as JSON alongside typed core columns) as a stated convention for all future crawlers, specifically to support adding new enrichment fields later without a backfill or restart.
8. HISTORICAL DEPTH PER DATASET: document in DECISIONS.md the per-dataset depth decision (OHLCV/fundamentals: maximum available; corporate events: already full by default; news F003/F004: cannot be backfilled, accumulates forward only from first crawl -- this constrains when F201 can run a meaningful sample).
features.verification: pytest tests/ -v with zero path filters, full collected/passed/xfailed counts pasted as literal stdout and matching every individual feature's evidence field exactly; DECISIONS.md contains dated entries for items 2-5 and 8 above (scope reconciliation, revision-handling choice, corporate-action-adjustment choice, dedup policy, per-dataset depth); item 6's orchestrator has its own test proving a simulated interrupted batch resumes without re-crawling already-succeeded symbols; item 7 is reflected as a new conventions.md entry.

features.name: Cross-dataset validation gate
features.behavior: A validation pass that runs after F009 (the F0xx tier checkpoint) confirms the whole crawler tier is genuinely solid: checks referential consistency across datasets (every symbol in market_ohlcv_daily exists in dim_symbol; every news item's symbol is valid; no dataset has a fetched_at in the future). This is a cross-dataset check ON TOP OF each crawler's own per-batch validation (which is part of F002-F007 individually) -- not a replacement for it, and not a substitute for F009's remediation of the cross-cutting gaps (corporate-action adjustment, fundamentals revision handling, news dedup) that referential-integrity checks alone would not catch.
features.verification: python -m pipeline.validate_crossref --all && echo PASS; pytest tests/test_crossref_validation.py -x  (fails loudly on a deliberately injected orphan symbol)

features.name: Point-in-time news+price+fundamental join
features.behavior: Join F003/F004 (news), F002 (price), F005 (fundamentals) using available_at so no feature is ever visible before its real-world disclosure/publish time. Output: an events table (symbol, published_at, headline, sentiment placeholder, price_at_publish, price_t+1, price_t+5, price_t+30, latest available fundamentals as of published_at).
features.verification: pytest tests/test_pit_join.py -x  (synthetic fixture: a news item published after market close is NOT joined to that same day's close; a fundamental row is NOT visible before its available_at) -- explicit look-ahead-bias unit test, this is the single most important test in the repo

features.name: PROOF: sentiment mean-reversion backtest on VN30 (gate for the model layer)
features.behavior: Cheap rule-based sentiment scorer (not the fine-tuned SLM yet) on the F102 events table. Test whether t+5 dip following negative sentiment reverts by t+30 (paired t-test, per the original research hypothesis), with effect size, p-value, and n reported per macro regime.
features.verification: python -m pipeline.backtest_meanreversion --report out/meanreversion_report.json && pytest tests/test_meanreversion_stats.py -x  (report contains effect size + p-value + n; bit-identical output on re-run)

features.name: PhoBERT-base fine-tune for VN financial sentiment
features.behavior: Fine-tune PhoBERT-base (VRAM budget: RTX 3060 6GB, fp16, gradient accumulation) on F003/F004 news, labeled via ViFinClass or equivalent. Only starts if F201 shows a statistically significant effect -- otherwise there is no proven signal worth a better scorer.
features.verification: python -m models.train_sentiment --config configs/phobert_base.yaml && pytest tests/test_sentiment_eval.py -x  (held-out F1 >= threshold stated before training; no OOM on target GPU)

features.name: Re-run F201 backtest using fine-tuned SLM scores
features.behavior: Same statistical test as F201, sentiment now from F301. Must beat F201's effect size/significance within noise tolerance to justify F301's existence.
features.verification: python -m pipeline.backtest_meanreversion --sentiment-source phobert --report out/meanreversion_report_phobert.json  (programmatic comparison against F201's report; test asserts not worse within stated tolerance)

features.name: Local inference service (read-only, no trading logic)
features.behavior: FastAPI/CLI service: headline+ticker in, F301 sentiment score + latest F005 fundamental snapshot out. No order logic, no broker connection.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_inference_service.py -x  (known headline returns expected sentiment class within tolerance; latency budget met on target hardware)

features.name: Feedback log for scored predictions vs realized returns
features.behavior: Every F401 prediction logged with inputs, back-filled with realized t+5/t+30 return once available -- enables drift monitoring with no live trading involved.
features.verification: pytest tests/test_feedback_log.py -x  (logged prediction correctly back-filled by a scheduled job given synthetic future price data)
